exposure: Failed operative vaginal delivery (FOVD) and second-stage emergency cesarean section (EmCS)
cohort: Secundiparous women with history of previous delivery
finding: Previous failed operative vaginal delivery and second-stage emergency cesarean section, and elective cesarean section were associated with increased risk of obstetric anal sphincter injuries in subsequent vaginal delivery compared to primiparous women, whereas previous vaginal delivery with intact perineum was associated with decreased risk.
